(Currently Amended) 1. A method of providing information regarding a product through a computing device, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.  
(Currently Amended) 19. The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user through a computing device.  
(Currently Amended) 23. The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to a role of the user, wherein the role is explicitly defined as a healthcare provider or caregiver.  
(Currently Amended) 24. The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for the user device used to receive the information.  
(Currently Amended) 27. A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: an apparatus for receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and an apparatus for generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.
